card.name: Verbs before 'in combination with' phrases
card.fires_on: The word right before a 'with' or 'and' pairing phrase, most often 'used' or 'taken' after 'when' in drug interaction statements. It also fires on 'with' or 'and' in pairings of two parties or things.

modes.label: Drug co-use
modes.description: Verb after 'when' that leads into 'in combination with' or 'concomitantly with' another drug.
modes.example: A lower dose of insulin or insulin secretagogue may be required to minimize the risk of hypoglycemia when<< used>> in combination with bexaglif

modes.label: Reciprocal pairs
modes.description: A word inside a two-way pairing of people or things, such as trade with, earth and cloud, or husband and wife.
modes.example: between a cloud and the earth, or earth<< and>> cloud; more rarely observed is the electrical

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue a two-way or reciprocal relation, though the listed tokens are mostly noise.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a drug is said to be used together with another drug, and on similar two-way pairings.
